title: Agent Lifecycle Common Schema
description: ALR-1101 (Agent Lifecycle Record, Part 1): the shared closed-vocabulary definitions for the four orthogonal record axes -- governance, identity, coverage, comparability -- plus the trust-level authority ceiling and the bounded reason vocabulary they all draw from. This document is a resolved definitions target: no axis constrains another (each closed type binds its own trust_level/reason-codes independently), unknown/legacy inputs resolve to the least-authority value rather than being echoed, and no client-supplied evidence can ever produce server_verified. The generic AxisValue base is intentionally not referenced by anything else in this file -- it exists only to document the shared shape and to let tests demonstrate why each axis needs its own closed oneOf instead of accepting any value/trust_level/reason-array combination. The root of this document resolves to AgentLifecycleAxisSet purely as a convenient, uniform validation entry point for this story's corpus; every individual axis definition remains independently $ref-able by future route schemas. Reserved-but-producerless values (identity VERIFIED; governance ADVISORY/STRICT; comparability COMPARABLE/NON_COMPARABLE) are intentionally schema-VALID here -- Part 1 has no route that emits them, which is a producer/service-level guarantee owned by later stories, not a schema-level rejection. ALR-1102 (Terra review P2-2) adds StableOpaqueRef/TypedOpaqueRef here: PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:276-299 defines both as common types every Part 1 route consumes, so hosting them in a single route's request file would have forced every later Route 1/2/5 story to depend on a consumer route document instead of this shared definitions target. Every route schema that names an opaque ref field narrows kind at its own use site via allOf and additionally carries its own x-disclosure annotation there (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:406-409: the worked disclosure table assigns rules per exact (document, JSON Pointer) use site, not once at the shared type) -- TypedOpaqueRef.kind/id/version_id and StableOpaqueRef.kind/id below carry only the generic deterministic-assignment fallback rule for whichever caller does not override it.

OpaqueRefId.description: Not a name, digest, tenant id, or content-derived public capability (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:285, :294-295).

kind.description: Part 1 StableOpaqueRef kinds only (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:284); each use site further constrains this to its exact kind.

StableOpaqueRef.description: Names a longitudinal, non-versioned resource that outlives any single snapshot of it (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:280). Has no version_id field at all -- additionalProperties:false rejects one (corpus case typed_ref_stable_kind_includes_version_id, PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:287, :1058).

kind.description: Full Part 1 TypedOpaqueRef kind vocabulary (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:293), including reserved kinds with no Part 1 producer; each use site further constrains this to its exact kind.

version_id.description: Identifies one immutable version; never 'latest' (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:295). version_id==id is required for every immutable-snapshot kind in this beta contract (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:299), but that cross-field equality is service_invalid, not schema-decidable (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:971, corpus case typed_ref_immutable_kind_version_id_mismatch) -- proved by a Backend-side test, not this schema.

TypedOpaqueRef.description: Content-free object naming one immutable, once-minted snapshot (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:289).

TrustLevel.description: The authority ceiling shared by every axis. client_attested: sourced from client-supplied input, never independently verified. backend_observed: Backend read or derived this from its own persisted state. server_verified: reserved for a canonical Backend-managed verification issuer; structurally legal but has no Part 1 producer. No client-supplied evidence may ever resolve to server_verified.

BoundedReasonCode.description: The frozen Part 1 public reason vocabulary, pinned exactly (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:260/264) -- not a superset, not a subset. The first ten members are the emittable allowlist every Part 1 route may actually produce. CONTRACT_MISMATCH and REQUIRED_CONTRACT_UNKNOWN are reserved in this common enum for a future Part 2 comparability/decision producer so that producer can use them without a breaking enum change; Part 1 has no code path that emits either one, but they remain structurally legal on the reserved ComparabilityVerdictAxisValue.NON_COMPARABLE branches this schema defines. No free text and no unenumerated code is legal anywhere reason-codes appear.

AxisValue.description: Closed structural base requiring exactly value/trust_level/reason-codes; the reason array is always unique, including when empty. Not a public escape hatch: nothing else in this document references this definition directly, and no route schema may either. Every public governance/identity/comparability/coverage property must use its own axis-specific closed definition below, each of which binds trust_level and the reason array structurally per legal value instead of accepting any combination this generic base alone would allow.

GovernanceProfileAxisValue.description: Closed governance-profile axis. OBSERVED is the only value any Part 1 route ever emits: Backend's DB/server default, ORM default, backfill, and read fallback all yield OBSERVED, and unknown or legacy governance inputs resolve to it rather than being echoed back. ADVISORY and STRICT remain reserved -- structurally legal, always backend_observed with no bound reason -- but authorize no Part 1 action and have no Part 1 response producer.

IdentityStateAxisValue.description: Closed oneOf over the four structurally legal identity tuples. Reserved VERIFIED is exactly server_verified/[REGISTERED_PROVENANCE] but has no Part 1 producer. Live RECONSTRUCTED is exactly client_attested/[DECLARED_PROVENANCE]; historical RECONSTRUCTED is exactly client_attested/[LEGACY_RECONSTRUCTED] -- the historical trust floor is deliberate: the join is Backend-observed but the underlying provenance originated client-side. Live UNKNOWN is exactly client_attested/[REQUIRED_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN] and always retains that reason; it can never become VERIFIED, and no other tuple is legal.

ComparabilityVerdictAxisValue.description: Closed oneOf over the four structurally legal comparability tuples. A single-record read is exactly NOT_APPLICABLE/backend_observed/[SINGLE_SUBJECT] -- Part 1's only actively producible branch. COMPARABLE requires an identical measurement-contract basis between the two records under comparison and carries no caveat reason (backend_observed/[]). NON_COMPARABLE is the mandatory verdict whenever that basis is not identical -- bound to the reserved CONTRACT_MISMATCH reason -- or whenever a required comparison input is unknown -- bound to the reserved REQUIRED_CONTRACT_UNKNOWN reason -- never a permissive default. All three non-NOT_APPLICABLE branches remain reserved with no Part 1 Route 5 producer; no delta or recommendation is emitted in Part 1.

RecordMeasurementCoverage.description: Closed oneOf between (a) a selected live COMPLETE reconciliation, (b) a selected live PARTIAL reconciliation, (c) a bound private legacy marker with state=UNKNOWN, basis=UNKNOWN_LEGACY_BASIS, all eight counts exactly null, trust_level=client_attested, and a reason array const [LEGACY_RECONSTRUCTED], and (d) an unmeasured projection with state=UNMEASURED, all eight counts schema-const 0, and basis NO_EVIDENCE_EPISODE|NO_SEALED_EVIDENCE_EPISODE selected from live episode cardinality. Every accepted eight-count object carries duplicate as schema-const 0 (const null on the legacy-marker branch, alongside the other seven counts) per the 2026-08-09 owner accounting decision (OWNER_DECISION_ACCOUNTING_20260809.md): expected/produced/cached/missing/failed/fallback/excluded/duplicate are the complete accepted count set; no ninth accounting field is legal on any branch.

reason_codes.description: COMPLETE carries no caveat reason unless the underlying contract is client-attested (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:262/752): assignment-free, exactly [] or [CLIENT_ATTESTED_ONLY].

PARTIAL always carries INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE_EPISODE, optionally alongside CLIENT_ATTESTED_ONLY when the underlying contract is client-attested (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:262/752): assignment-free, no other code is legal here.

Part1RecordGovernanceProfile.description: TYPE vs PRODUCER split (sol ruling on ALR-1101 P1-2, 2026-08-09): GovernanceProfileAxisValue stays the wide 3-branch closed vocabulary (OBSERVED/ADVISORY/STRICT) per PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:69-78, unconstrained here -- but the field a Part 1 record composition may actually carry is narrower. Per :220, Part 1's record route emits only OBSERVED/backend_observed/[]; ADVISORY and STRICT remain valid at the common axis-type level for a future producer, never on this record.

Part1RecordComparabilityVerdict.description: TYPE vs PRODUCER split (sol ruling on ALR-1101 P1-2, 2026-08-09): ComparabilityVerdictAxisValue stays the wide closed vocabulary (COMPARABLE/NON_COMPARABLE/NOT_APPLICABLE) per PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:69-78, unconstrained here -- but a Part 1 single-record read may only ever emit NOT_APPLICABLE/backend_observed/[SINGLE_SUBJECT] per :223. COMPARABLE and NON_COMPARABLE remain valid at the common axis-type level for a future Part 2 comparison producer, never on this record (corpus case record_comparable_single_subject, PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md schema_invalid #17).

AgentLifecycleAxisSet.description: The reusable set of orthogonal axis fields that a Part 1 record composes from this common schema: governance_profile, identity_state, measurement_coverage, comparability_verdict. Each axis validates independently -- no combination of one axis's legal value narrows what another axis may legally hold -- and the closed object rejects any field this set does not name. governance_profile and comparability_verdict are further narrowed to what Part 1 actually produces (Part1RecordGovernanceProfile/Part1RecordComparabilityVerdict); identity_state and measurement_coverage use their full common axis types directly since Part 1 genuinely produces more than one branch of each.
